report.scope: Signal events, and for each ACTIONABLE idea which of its target or invalidation the later imported bars touched first, in net R. A bar touching both is AMBIGUOUS, bars ending first is OPEN, and no hit rate or mean R is published below the sample floor. It is not P&L, because fills, slippage past the stop and position size are not modelled, and the definitions are untuned, versioned hypotheses.
